title: Why Niko Bellic really came to Liberty City in GTA 4
subject: niko
description:
Would you have trusted Roman's emails? 👇

The war, the sinking ship and the lie that brought Niko Bellic to Liberty City. Spoilers for Grand Theft Auto IV.

scenes.text: Niko Bellic was barely a teenager when war made him a soldier.
In the Yugoslav Wars, his unit of fifteen men walked into an ambush.
Only three survived. Niko was sure one was a traitor.
After the war he smuggled people across the Adriatic, until a ship sank and Ray Bulgarin blamed him.
So Niko hid at sea for months, until the cargo ship Platypus docked in Liberty City.
His cousin Roman had promised mansions and sports cars. Instead, Niko found a cramped apartment and gambling debts.
